qa_pair.question: Using the pinned PostgreSQL manual, compare the relation lock needed for a plain table read with the strongest table lock. Which mode is the only one that conflicts with the plain read's mode? Return the SQL lock-mode name.

From the pinned PostgreSQL locking and maintenance documentation, distinguish normal maintenance from the version that rewrites an entire table. What table lock does the rewriting VACUUM variant require? Return the lock-mode name.

A PostgreSQL diagnosis wants actual row counts and timings but must avoid retaining the side effects of a data-changing statement. Read the pinned execution-plan guide and identify the SQL command that ends its recommended protective transaction. Return only the command.

Using the PostgreSQL activity-monitoring snapshot, identify the boolean setting required to gather read/write timing in the database statistics view, distinct from ordinary activity tracking. Return the configuration name.

Using the PostgreSQL monitoring document, distinguish a backend doing no work inside an open transaction from one actively running a statement but waiting. What is the exact state string for the former? Return that state string.

Compare MySQL locks on individual index entries with a lock on an entry plus the interval immediately preceding it, using the pinned InnoDB manual. Which named lock type describes the latter? Return its lower-case singular name.

In the pinned InnoDB lock discussion, compare interval locks with ordinary record locks. Can conflicting shared and exclusive interval locks be held on the same interval by different transactions? Return True or False.
Read the pinned InnoDB buffer-pool explanation and distinguish its old sublist from its new sublist. What fraction of the pool is the old sublist by default? Return a reduced fraction.

Read the pinned InnoDB buffer-pool discussion, including aging after insertion and access. Which variable controls the delay before a newly inserted old-sublist page is eligible to become young? Return its configuration name.

Compare both pinned execution-plan guides. A proposed diagnosis claims MySQL ANALYZE TABLE and PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE have the same purpose: measuring a query's actual execution timings. Is that claim correct? Read the manuals without executing either command. Return True or False.
